QuestInfo.name: Shulynch's Training 1
QuestInfo.0: It's time to get down to training! You intend to be the best Pirate around!
QuestInfo.1: #b#p1092008##k is sending you to the Training Center to fight #rOctoPirates#k. Take down 30 of the suckers!
QuestInfo.2: Not bad. That was a piece of cake.

0.0: Combat is the best form of training, I always say. Are you ready to begin?

yes.0: The monsters inside won't hold back, so you shouldn't, either. When you're ready, go into the Training Room and eliminate #r30 OctoPirates#k. I'll be watching.

no.0: You aren't scared, are you? That's probably smart.

1.0: Still alive? I'm surprised. I may make a real Pirate out of you yet.

yes.0: And now we're done with warm-ups.

mob.0: If you can't even eliminate #b30 OctoPirates#k, just go home.
